description: Per-run readout of the 32 v0.6 map-level replays: 8 checkpoints x 2 test sequences x 2 forward passes, each an out/v06_score/map_<tag>.json written by tools/map_eval.py. Out-of-frustum subset only; the source files are not published, each run carries its source's SHA-256. tools/v06_report.py reads exactly these fields to write REPORT.txt.

conventions.units: IoU and mIoU in percent; common-9 label space
conventions.outside: out-of-frustum points by the score_2d_vs_3d.Projector P3 rule on the raw sensor-frame point; for the per-cell readings, cells whose scored points are majority out-of-frustum
conventions.offline_all: per-scan predictions on every evaluated point (no abstention exists)
conventions.map_all_lookup: the fused 0.20 m map (confidence gate 0.5, FAST-LIVO2 trajectory of the sequence) looked up at every evaluated point. `miou9` and `per_class_iou` exclude points that land in no voxel, the convention of REPORT.txt and of the evaluation-unit tables; `miou9_abstain_wrong` counts them wrong, the convention of v0.5's headline map number
conventions.anatomy_voxel: every map cell once: cell GT = majority GT of its scored points, cell prediction = the fused class; `sparse_oracle_miou` relabels the cells with n_obs <= 4 to their GT majority; `wrong` counts cells whose fused class differs from their GT majority
conventions.reweighted_map_vs_scan: each cell weight 1 spread evenly over its scored points; the map prediction and the per-scan prediction are scored on the same points against the same GT
conventions.map_voxels: all voxels of the run's map, every subset
conventions.points_evaluated: every evaluated point of the sequence, every subset; the out-of-frustum count is outside.offline_all.n_eval

aggregation_in_report: An arm is every run of its checkpoints: B0 and B0_noKL 3 seeds x 2 passes = 6 runs, ZS and Rprime_noKL 1 checkpoint x 2 passes. Main table: mean and population SD (statistics.pstdev, divisor n) over the arm's runs. Section 1 and 2: arm means. Section 3, per-scan offline_all: between-seed = pstdev of the three per-seed means, within-seed = mean over seeds of the pstdev of the two passes; 'seed spread is real' when between > 2 x within. Section 5: plain means.
caveat: armB0_noKL_s2's checkpoint comes from a resume that restarted epoch 10 from the released weights (see training/val_curves.json, resume_audit); it is not a ten-epoch no-KL run, and every B0_noKL aggregate includes it.
reproduces: tools/v06_report.py re-run over the 32 source files reproduces results/v06/scoring/REPORT.txt byte for byte (checked on 2026-09-26).
